notes.content:
Hey everyone. It's been a long time (again)!

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Some minor bugs have been fixed[/b].
[*] [b]Potential fix for rare dialogue soft-lock bug.[/b] 
There's been a rare bug where some people get soft-locked for a minute after trying to progress a dialogue. I've never been able to replicate the issue, but thanks to the victims of the bug & through the power of communication I think I may have determined the cause of the issue and rewrote the system that I suspect was causing it. If you've been running into this issue and couldn't continue playing due to this, please give version 1.0.41 a try. It would also be great if you could comment here or message in [url=https://discord.gg/t5YqxDG]Discord[/url] whether this fixed it for you.
[*] [b]The engine has been ported from Gamemaker Studio 2.2 to Gamemaker Studio 2.3[/b]. 
The new software syntax is much stricter so this required many manual changes. We tested everything as much as we could and took care of anything that we found was wrong, but due to the size of the game and player choice there's always a chance we could've missed something. So if you run into any new bugs, it would be really helpful if you'd like to share them in our [url=https://discord.gg/t5YqxDG]Discord[/url] server. If the update somehow prevents you from progressing, you can always revert to the previous version via right clicking Wuppo in your Steam library > properties > betas > revert

notes.title: Wuppo: Definitive Edition releases on Steam, Mac, GOG & Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25094187/ceb0af2571aa876665ab2e1ef645cf110be3ed83.png[/img]
[i]Wuppo: Definitive Edition is now available on Steam (Windows &  [b]Mac[/b]), [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] and GOG![/i]

[list][*]There will be a [b]Daily deal with 50% off [/b]for Wuppo: Definitive Edition on Steam, starting [b]10AM Pacific Time[/b], which is also when the DLC will be added to the base game (for free).
[*]Wuppo: Definitive Edition will release later [b]today[/b] on Nintendo Switch (time depending on where you live).
[/list]

[h1]BIG THANK YOU[/h1]
First of all, *BIG THANK YOU* to everyone that shared Wuppo, streamed Wuppo, left a good review, provided us with feedback, begged for a Switch version, or just did anything at all to help us show this game to the world. Wuppo has been an incredibly important part of (more than 1/3rd of) our entire lives. Thanks to you, we were able to continue working on it for so long and make it as good as we possibly can.

[h1]Definitive Edition Description:[/h1]
We’ve constantly been updating Wuppo since its release in 2016. Adding Boss Run, a minimap, and many more things. But we haven’t shared anything that we’ve been working on for the past year. We took a good hard look at Wuppo and all the feedback we’ve been getting, and tried to finetune... basically [i]everything[/i]. We added some cutscenes, redesigned some bosses, added visual improvements, refined the soundtrack, added some additional content, created solutions for potentially frustrating parts. Our main purpose was to finetune the experience for as many players as possible from beginning to end. So it is [i]the same Wuppo you know & love, but better[/i]!

Here I'll list some of the changes. Beware of [b][u]SPOILERS[/u][/b].

[code]
[b]Co-Op:[/b]
We added co-op (couch), where the 2nd player can play as Denksnavel. Our main goal of this feature was to provide a little help to players that need it. So if you’re having trouble with a specific boss, or just need an extra pair of eyes to look for clues, make your friend / parent jump in at any time with Denksnavel. 

[b]Visual updates:[/b][list][*]More dynamic lighting. Lights can cast subtle shadows on the terrain. The characters also receive light on their bodies.
[*]Fog: Sometimes the area gets wet / foggy.
[*]updated maps: A few maps have been refined.
[*]The camera now zooms in at some of the more important cutscenes
[*]Some colour palettes have been refined and the game is a bit brighter during night time.[/list]

[b]Audio updates:[/b]
[list][*]A couple of brand new songs have been added to the game, and many songs have been retouched slightly. We tried to create a better structure for the soundtrack from beginning to end, with some more recurring themes, highlights and consistency in quality.
[*]The important NPCs also have more varying voices, giving them much more personality.[/list]

[b]New / changed areas:[/b]
[list][*]New trainstation: Wisest Wum: Ever wanted to test your Wuppo knowledge? Well, now you can. Wisest Wum is a quiz show that gets hosted at one of the train stations. You can earn (or lose) a lot of smurt by contending.
[*][spoiler]Redav Kned’s Guesthouse[/spoiler] has been made easier. The original difficulty is still available when playing the game on INSANE. The [spoiler]ritual[/spoiler] has also been reworked to give much better feedback to the player and help solve it.[/list]

[b]Boss changes:[/b]
[list][*]The final boss has been completely reworked. It’s super important to us that the game ends in a spectacular manner. After watching players fighting the boss and receiving feedback, we ultimately thought we could’ve done a much better job, so we just started over. We tried to bring back everything the player has learned from previous fights. We really hope you enjoy the renewed fight.
[*]King Blione: has an extra attack
[*]Blafknoft’s attacks changed a bit.
[*]All other bosses received some (smaller) changes as well. Either balancing, or improving player feedback.
[/list]

[b]Happiness hints:[/b]
Our mutual friend Toekomsthakker now has a new feature, where he gives you hints for any of the happiness that the player is missing. A great excuse to spend your Wondersplenk Coins.

[b]New items:[/b]
We added a light bulb and a blusser outfit. The light bulb makes you glow in the dark for 7 minutes, and the blusser outfit can be used as a skin when using [spoiler]bucket[/spoiler].

[b]Added & adjusted dialogues:[/b]
We saw an opportunity to improve the quality on some of the dialogues. Most of the changes are modifications on existing dialogues, but there’s some additional dialogues as well for the new cutscenes / new area.

[b]Gamepad/Controller controls:[/b]
A new shortcut menu has been added when playing with a Controller. It acts like an inventory with 9 slots, but it’s very quick & easy to select the desired item. Also, without the need to memorize which specific buttons you have directed to specific items. The game also runs in slow motion when using this feature during boss fights.

[b]Additional QOL changes[/b][list]
[*]Game now pauses if you browse your inventory during a boss fight.
[*]Added a couple more Autosaves throughout the game.
[*]Losing an item doesn’t make you lose the hotkey until you change it. Which is useful if you just throw your gumgumgun in the gumcore machine and regain it within a couple of seconds.
[*]Game automatically adds hotkeys for new items (optional)
[*]Reworked the options menu to be easier to read, as well as providing some additional graphics settings.
[*]Blieken instrument controls have been made more flexible. Some people didn’t realise they had to hold the action button while picking a note. Now you can use it either way.
[*]Boss run score: one of the scores now indicates how many times you’ve been hit rather than how much damage you’ve received.[/list]

[b]DLC = free[/b]
As it is now called the "Definitive Edition", all DLC is included for free. The Original Soundtrack, the Bonus shops and the Wuppo Fun Pack are now included into the base game. The price of the base game stays the same.

[b]Performance:[/b]
The game's performance has been massively increased and also uses "delta time". Which comes down to that it handles frame-drops better. Keep in mind that you can tweak the settings in graphics to ensure 60fps. The game will give a warning if you dip below 60fps.
[/code]
[b][u]tl;dr: Game is better.[/u][/b]

This will be the final big update for Wuppo, as we’ll be moving on to our new game now. If you like Wuppo: Definitive Edition, please share it with your friends/family, let us know in a steam review, tell your favorite streamer to play it. Thanks x 1000!

Please follow us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/knuistperzik]Twitter[/url][/b] for updates on our projects and/or join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/t5YqxDG] Discord[/url][/b] community chat if you're looking for other Wuppo friends :D

Cheers!
Lars & Thomas

notes.title: Wuppo Patch Notes [1.1.40*] Balance tweaks, subtle improvements & fixes
notes.content:
HELLO :D

Super small update. But still a [b][u]SPOILER ALERT[/u][/b]!
              
[h1]UPDATES:[/h1][list]
[*] Chef Fnaquere's damage has been nerfed. He became a bit too difficult with his AI update when fighting outside of the soup (in 1.1.34).
[*] You can now skip the Boss Run transition by clicking or pressing the action button on gamepad mode.
[*] New Blione village is now a little livelier ([spoiler]The area where you fight Blafknoft[/spoiler]). 
[*] There's an alternate saving effect when jumping in a bucket (like with autosaving).
[*] Balancing tweaks for a couple of bosses on easy mode (Murk, Fnakker Friends, Bankkrent phase 2).
[*] Bathing gives you happiness faster than before.
[*] Minifnak now has a mild randomized body colour (but all save files created prior to this update will still have the original colour).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] An error that sometimes appeared when fighting the Fnakker Friends has been fixed.
[*] Scrolling through your items at exactly the right (/wrong) time while jumping into the sinkhole or the train tunnel no longer freezes you.
[*] Sometimes you didn't shoot automatically by aiming when fighting Zwepel, fixed.
[*] Beating Bankkrent phase 1 extremely quick before the actual fight music starts used to start the music during and after the cutscene. Not anymore!
[*] Quickly using the lift to flee the Church Fnakkers now correctly cancels the fight music and the boss will re-appear when coming back.

notes.title: Wuppo Patch Notes [1.1.33] Whistle powerup, Polish & Fixes
notes.content:
HI! :D

Here are all the changes since: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/400630/announcements/detail/486793695379927397]version 1.1.29[/url]

([u][b]SPOILER ALERT[/b][/u]).

[h1]UPDATES:[/h1][list]
[*] You can upgrade your whistling technique now. Good luck finding out how!
[*] Zwepel the Deadly Pumpkin Nightmare Disaster (The Halloween Boss) has been added to Boss Run. If you manage to complete an All Boss Run within 25 minutes, you get 1 chance to beat him. This should not affect your achievements (once you passed the final boss you should be safe to unlock those). However, beating Zwepel would probably guarantee you a #1 spot on the leader boards.

[*] A couple more balancing tweaks to Easy Mode (BETA).
[*] There have been some tiny dialogue updates throughout the game, also some bad jokes were added sorry.
[*] The final boss & Zwepel are now also counted in the "Total bosses" stat.
[*] Beating the 2 super creepy creatures in Redav Kned's Guesthouse now puts them on a cool down for 5 minutes.
[*] A couple of SFX have been tweaked/updated.
[*] A couple more bosses now get a subtle lighting change when you start fighting.
[*] A small fnuist light that follows you spawns during the final boss when it's getting really dark.
[*] A couple of changes have been added regarding to paying by equiping a smurt / wondersplenk coin and throwing it on an NPC. It should work a lot quicker now. Currently this is exclusively for the 3 shops in Wondersplenk (where it was most needed).
[*] Toned down a bit on the extremely colour-flashing-moments in the game that attempted to give you a seizure.
[*] You can now additionally leave the Tussen warp bubbles by whistling.
[*] You no longer fall asleep during dialogues, except during Bert Smulder's dialogue or during filmstrips.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] A bunch of typos/grammatical errors throughout the dialogues have been fixed.
[*] Moving through the tiles in your item inventory while playing in gamepad mode sometimes unexpectedly skipped a tile. Not anymore!
[*] Your HP stat no longer "randomly" appears in the big Wondersplenk map.
[*] You can no longer start a conversation with Allesdenker while the projector is starting up.
[*] You can no longer talk to the Coffee Popo when you're standing outside of the house.
[*] You can open your inventory now when fighting the "Fnakker Friends".
[*] Snackbarry no longer disses you by closing his snack bar while you are selling him a dead kneft when it gets dark.
[*] Balloons should make sound again when you jump on them.
[*] The Wumhouse is no longer empty when you warp there from Tussen.
[*] You can no longer kill multiple yellow blocks with 1 gumball.
[*] Running away after starting the cleaning quest can no longer give you an error.
[*] A potential error that could happen during the final boss fight has been fixed. [/list]

You can also download new Wuppo friends here: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/KadWT4b]https://discordapp.com/invite/KadWT4b[/url]

Cheers & have fun playing!
- LARS

[h1] Updates (since 1.1.12) [/h1]
[b]Achievement changes:[/b]
[list][*]You can now get the World champion achievement by beating Boss Run mode under 25 minutes.

[*]You can now additionally scroll through the dialogue options with the D-pad.

notes.title: Thanks, Happy New Year! & patch notes 1.1.6
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all, THANKS. We've had a good time these past 3 months. We’ve FINALLY released the project we started over 6 years ago. And we're super proud of the reactions Wuppo has gotten so far. And even though a lot of people (including us, of course xD) think Wuppo has still gotten far less attention than it should have, we can't really complain. Reading how people have been waiting for 6 years, and still call it worth it, over and over again. Seeing people call Wuppo their GOTY. Watching in-depth lore discussions in the Wuppo Discord. We've even seen many people calling Wuppo the best indie game they have ever played. There is more than enough to keep us going. So Thank you VERY much for the amazing (and ongoing) support!

We'll gladly continue supporting Wuppo in 2017 and see what else we can accomplish. Let's continue to grow the game & the community! :D We've also learned a LOT, so we are excited to put that to test and start planning our next project in the meantime...

Thanks & Happy New Year!
- Knuist & Perzik

notes.title: Wuppo's big "Boss Run" update is now available for free! & Patch notes 1.1.4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25094187/2bfe28456ef3cb3dbd2a5488e9d0fbf05f5f83da.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wuppo's first big update has arrived and is now available for free![/h1] 
The update contains two brand new game modes that will be available after completing the game, named "Boss Run" and "Practice Mode". Boss Run will test your skills by putting you in front of all bosses one by one, in one go. Of course, for this you'll have to be a well-trained Wuppo player, and that's where Practice Mode comes in. In this mode, you can practice fighting against any boss individually, to make sure you're well prepared to fight any boss at any time.

[h1]New features (available after completing the game)[/h1]
[list][*]Boss Run mode; in which you can try defeating all bosses in one try
[*]Practice mode; in which you can choose what boss you want to fight
[*]Score system; based on how fast you complete it, and how many times you get hit.
[*]Online Leaderboards; (Steam version only) to compete with everyone around the world! (Or with your friends if you're afraid of the world)
[*]8 Brand new achievements[/list]

[h1]Watch the trailer here:[/h1] https://youtu.be/JdN3kazW3dY
EDIT: If you have beaten the main game already, loading your savefile once and saving the game again should unlock the boss run mode.

EDIT2: Released a small patch (version 1.1.1, ~4mb update), which checks whether you have the achievement for beating the game. This way Boss Run will be unlocked no matter what, as long as you finished story mode once (even if you uninstalled the game in the meantime).

[h1] Patch Notes 1.1.4 [/h1]

([b][u]SPOILER[/u][/b] Alert!)

[h1] Changes (since 1.0.28) [/h1]
[list]
[*]... [b]Boss Run! [/b](see above)
[*][b]Water update:[/b]
A lot of people really liked the bucket weapons, but we felt they weren't as useful as they could be, because their ammo runs out quick. So we added "water drops". They refill your water just like the HP hearts refill your HP. Enemies have a chance of dropping them, so now you can refill your bucket by fighting enemies. This should enable a much more fun dynamic for switching between buckets / gumgum guns.
[*] Eating fruit adds a little water.
[*] [b]Bankkrent Phase 2[/b]: 
One of the bullet attack patterns has been slowed down & altered so there's more room to maneuver through projectiles.
[*]Sinkhole no longer shakes after finishing and returning the game.
[*]Blione King has less HP.
[*]Made Bram's sound louder during the battle.
[*]Murk has been altered a bit.
[/list]

[h1] Fixes (since 1.0.28)[/h1]
[list][*] The bib fnakkers are moved to a different location if you skipped them and defeated Chef Fnaquere, rather than standing around at the food party.[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Wuppo patch notes 1.0.29*
notes.content:
Hello!

By the way, If you think Wuppo is cool and that it should [b]win an award for not winning an award while being so cool[/b], you can head over to the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/400630/]main page[/url] and nominate it for that in the purple area! B-)
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/400630/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25094187/d61f5eb1bd5e2f675faeb925995d24a495895e18.png[/img][/url] 
Don't forget to nominate all your favorite games! *EDIT: We didn't win :( Tough competition fighting for the popular vote. But thanks to everyone for voting & sharing! <3^99

In other news, here are the 1.0.29* patch notes ([u][b]SPOILER ALERT[/b][/u]), info about the [b]BETA channel[/b], and a a link to the Wuppo Discord at the bottom.

[h1]Changes (since 1.0.24)[/h1]
[b]Pedestal effect[/b]
Some people experienced the puzzle in the Redav Kned Guesthouse as extremely confusing. On one hand that's kind of what we went for, as the protagonist shouldn't have an idea what he/she's doing exactly and solve the puzzle 'by accident'. But we don't want it to be frustrating for the player. When players did the right thing, the game didn't give clear enough feedback. It takes a while before the puzzle reacts to your actions. So a small graphical & sound effect got added whenever you place 'the right item' on a pedestal. This way you immediately know whether you've done something right. This happens for all pedestals in the game, except the Scale in Redav Kned's Guesthouse.

[b]Blafknoft fight (a.k.a. Crab boss a.k.a. Giant Splenkhakker): [/b][list][*]Camera zooms out when there are giant rocks flying around. They were unnecessarily hard to dodge when the camera was zoomed in.
[*]The helper bliones are a bit easier to jump on. Also a little sound & effect got added.[/list]

[b]Other Changes: [/b][list][*]More [i]invincibility frames[/i] after getting hit by Bankkrent or his friends and various other bosses. This might make the game a bit easier for people who were struggling with bossfights.
[*]Fnakker rocks behave a little bit different. Should be a bit easier to avoid in certain situations.
[*]Wum looks a little bit different during [i]invincibility frames[/i].
[*]Subtle 'fnuist' effect added to whenever a creature dies.
[*]Added sfx to the scale in Redav Kned's Guesthouse.
[*]More optimisation for final boss fight (fps boost if you had low fps there).
[*]You can now use some of the rock spikes in the background to hide from the wall crack attack during the final boss fight.
[*]Stoplight  a.k.a. Traffic  Light With Fists now drops 16 splenkhakker coins instead of 20 smurt.
[*]When entering the Sinkhole / Bliekopolis, after leaving your pot helmet behind (for example in the Wumgarden), without finding the new pot helmet, Denksnavel will hint towards that new pot helmet.
[*]Made the partially broken wall in the Blenktower more visually notable. It was easy to miss and that would just leave the player clueless where to go, which doesn't seem like a fun "puzzle". Also fixed that it sometimes didn't get hit properly.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes(since 1.0.24)[/h1][list]
[*]View no longer appears stretched at the final boss if you are playing on a 16:10 resolution.
[*]Credits background got fixed for 16:10 resolutions.
[*]When there's a white flash, it's no longer displaced on 16:10 resolutions.
[*]Error at Lans & Merik when using the Breft cleaning suit while walking into the room got fixed.
[*]Using the Breft suit no longer wakes up Lans & Merik.
[*]There was an issue where you could get +10 Happiness in one world when finding filmstrips, and it'd be confusing to not get +5 in the final world. Should all be fixed now. If you think the game or an update screwed you and you missed happiness from finding filmstrips, you can head over to the Allesweter. If this is the case, it should automatically get fixed.
[*]Super rare Train glitch where the collision mask disappeared and you could fall of the sides should be fixed.
[*]A Bankkrent phase 2 attack behaved a bit weird and shot mudballs towards you, but now it shoots them up in a pattern which should be easier to avoid.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could sometimes double jump again after catching food mid air.
[*]Damage numbers will no longer combine when using rapid fire weapons, I thought it looked weird.
[*]If you got hit while standing on the ground and then fell off a cliff, you can use double jump now to recover after a short delay.
[*]Some cardboard boxes in the Wumhouse had wrong collision masks. Not anymore.
[*]The Cooks Story filmstrip checked the wrong world for whether you had all filmstrips and if it'd give you happiness.
[*]No longer get an error if you saved your file while wearing the blieken instrument and dying.
[*]You can no longer push the stone blieken back into the wall and get them stuck when performing Redav Kned's summoning ritual .
[*]You can no longer de-agro fnakker minibosses in the middle of the battle.
[*]Murk's (Café boss) bullets no longer display wrongly coloured particles.
[*]You didn't always equip your weapon after loading a savefile, fixed now.
[*]1.0.29 Fixed a bug where you would get soft locked if you get kicked out of Berdy's room while he's standing on the pizza box and then show the Blak Cake to  him.
[*]1.0.29 Fixed a bug where you would fall out of the screen if you weren't inside the middle chamber after winning the final boss fight.
[*] 1.0.29 Fixed a bug where you wouldn't get an achievement by getting the Popo Chipcard through Carlos + made a fix for if you missed it.
[/list]

If you find any glitches, please report them here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JpIfjEF0PmuFp-zpJn-__EMw6oNSym9vwkN6PfHY8hk/edit?pref=2&pli=1#gid=703231371

[h1][b]BETA channel opened![/b][/h1]
I try not to update more than once a week, to avoid messing with your internet speed too much due to auto updates. However, if you want to get the updates and fixes the quickest (& sneak peaks of future updates), here is how to join the BETA channel:

[*]Right click Wuppo in your library

[*]Enter the password: "Alleswetertweepuntnul" and click CHECK CODE
[/list]
It should now automatically change you to the BETA branch. Wuppo will display as "Wuppo [beta]" in your library.

Thanks for all the support & have fun playing!

notes.title: Wuppo patch notes 1.0.24
notes.content:
HI!

We added quite a few tweaks and some more fixes. So here are the patch notes. And the usual [b][u]SPOILER ALERT[/u][/b]!

[h1]Changes (since 1.0.21) [/h1]

[b]Popo City CREDIT balancing:[/b]
We didn't like how some people experienced Popo City as being 'grindy'. People that went through all the jobs a bit faster and figured out everything before the CREDIT counter got close to 100k, were kind of forced to grind jobs or afk until they reached the CREDIT goal.

We find the Popo City gameplay most enjoyable when the player just drifts off, trying to find out different ways to make money, interact with NPC's while in the background the CREDIT increases. So we focussed on increasing CREDIT in the background, rather than increasing the CREDIT rewards for jobs. Here are a couple of changes that hopefully improve the experience for every type of player:
[list]
[*]The CREDIT will increase much faster depending on how many jobs you tried out and whether you've figured out the kneft infestation. This way players still get enough time to try everything out, but once they've done most of the things there are to do, the game will help them get to the next stage quicker.

[*]Traavis Duivels' store is 10 times as cheap.
You will be able to buy CREDIT through Traavis' shop for less ridiculous prices. So if you've already made a lot of money and you want to push the CREDIT up faster (or if you're doing a speed-run), it's something to consider using. 
[/list]

[b]Fishing changes:[/b]
So far cheap hooks and good hooks had completely different reward tables. Cheap hooks never got you anything valuable, while good hooks did. You weren't able to find Hendricks hat with cheap hooks either. Some people might not have realised this, while enthusiastically fishing with cheap hooks. We want you to get fun rewards when fishing, whether you're using cheap or good hooks for whatever reason.
[list][*]Cheap hooks can get you just as valuable items as good hooks, but the chance to get a valuable item is lower.
[*]If you're really lucky, you can now also a chance to fish up gumcores.
[*]You can still ask for free hooks from Hendrick after giving his hat.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b][list]
[*]The alternative way to get a Popo Chipcard without buying or stealing it ([spoiler]yourself[/spoiler]), has been improved a bit.
[*]Fnakbal is now repeatable.
[*]Flipside has been altered a bit. [spoiler]There is also a new item available that might be helpful for defeating Bankkrent phase 2.[/spoiler]
[*]Added a few more situational dialogues.
[*]Can no longer fall asleep while wearing coffee hat ([spoiler]i c u raylazor[/spoiler]).
[*]Added location title graphics for Old Town, Central, the Sinkhole and Flipside.
[*]Slightly smaller chance to have to deliver in Old Town when delivering newspapers.
[*]Get 3 times as much smurt when delivering newspapers in Old Town.
[*]Some GPU optimalisation for light effects (should give a small fps boost in certain areas/situations on slower computers).
[*]New song has been added to the OST DLC (Bankkrent's Sorrow).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes (since1.0.21)[/h1][list]
[*]Music behaved a bit weird during the protest if Radio Dekster was activated. Fixed now.
[*]Some protest wums had no faces if the cutscene started while you were already in the room. Fixed now.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the ritual place by moving the walls down with your instrument before entering the room.
[*]There were a few loopholes that made it possible for a store to lose its items without you actually buying it. That should all be fixed now.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the ritual place in Redav Kned's Guesthouse by moving the walls down with your instrument before entering the room.
[*]You can now sign Betty's contract with your gamepad.
[*]Gumgum skins now also work with autofire setting on gamepad.
[*]Shopping DLC electric weapon now works with autofire on gamepad. (if you dislike autofire, you can change the hidden setting %localappdata%/wuppo/Wuppo_config.ini )
[*]Denksnavel will no longer "remind" you about Traavis if you haven't spoken to Traavis yet.
[*]Chefnaquer's bullets behaved weird.
[*]Various minor/rare bugfixes related to GUI graphics /gamepad mode, fnakbal, turning invisible and more stuff I don't remember right now :D
[/list]

If you find any glitches, please post them here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JpIfjEF0PmuFp-zpJn-__EMw6oNSym9vwkN6PfHY8hk/edit?pref=2&pli=1#gid=703231371
NOTE: Please update to the latest version before you post anything. 

* Also, updates shouldn't be over 100mb anymore starting from 1.0.21.

Thanks for your feedback, and have fun playing!
-LARS

notes.title: Wuppo 1.0.9 patch notes
notes.content:
HI!

Here are the version 1.0.9 patch notes:

[b]IMPORTANT CHANGES[/b]:
[list][*] Completely new controls section in the options window.
featuring: key bindings for keyboard & mouse.
[*] Shader optimization (for smoothness 0)
Optimization for the shader when smoothness is put to 0. This should result in a frame rate boost for anyone who's experiencing low fps and playing on lowest settings.
[*] Added an option to set the graphical settings to lowest, custom and highest, to make it a bit easier to quickly pick settings that match your specs.
[*] Game no longer displays the low fps warning when you're using the lowest settings (vsync off, smoothness 0).
[*] Switch between gamepad & keyboard mode by pressing a button on keyboard or gamepad.
[*] When choosing the XBOX controller preset, the hotkeys in your inventory will display as XBOX buttons instead of PS buttons.
[/list]

[b]DLC CHANGES[/b]:
[list][*] SHOP DLC: Added detective hat and a monocle to the OCSEDEO'S shops.
[*] WALLPAPERS: Added the steam banner in 1080p and 4K.
[/list]

[u] FROM HERE ON SPOILERS [/u]

[b]SMALL CHANGES [/b]:
[list][*] The newspaper suit no longer shows the reticle if you're in the wrong room.
[*] There were some hiding spots that could be exploited in Bankkrent phase 2, which have been removed.
[*] Bankkrent's phase 2 special bullet storm pattern for an attack has been altered a bit.
[*] Bankkrent's bullets are slower, and now also explode when hitting the ground.
[*] Added autosaves pre-Bankkrent phase 1 and post-Bankkrent phase 1.
[*] Ignore low FPS warning
The reason we wanted it in there is because playing the game with lower fps doesn't slow down the sound, resulting in lots of animations not being in sync with the sound. Especially later in the game this can lead to some particularly awkward cut scenes. Another reason is that Wuppo is supposed to run on 60fps, but not everyone notices that. Many games still play in 30fps. We've seen lots of people make the conclusion that Wuppo just plays very slow, which in our opinion, completely ruins the experience. So we highly recommend to lower your graphical settings if you aren't getting a stable 60fps. However, if you're aware of all this and you still want to play it on high settings, you can now edit the file called "Wuppo_config.ini" located in %localappdata%/wuppo/ And change "ignore_framerate" from 0 to 1.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]:
[list][*] An error that came when bulk selling when clicking too low on the bag has been resolved.
[*] Historian Achievement didn't get activated (if you already had every filmstrip, you can re-watch a filmstrip and it will get activated ).
[*] Some of the happiness achieved from collecting all filmstrips in an area didn't work correctly  (if you've missed anything, it's fixed after re-watching a filmstrip if you have all of them).
[*] Bram (goggled wum) didn't count as a boss in the progress window.
[*] A chance to get an error while busting wums out of jail has been fixed.
[*] Buying hooks from Hendrick was a bit too cheap, as you you were able to sell good hooks for more than you bought them in a short time.
[*] Dialogue choice box didn't disappear when you talked to City Hall members while a new discussion started.
[*] There were some frame drop issues when alt+tabbing out and in the game. Now all shaders will reset when tabbing back into the game, hopefully that way we can avoid most of these frame drop moments.
[*] Game now loads your brightness settings when restarting the game.
[*] An error that appeared when performing Redav Kned's ritual while having a low framerate has been resolved.
[*] You can no longer perform the 2nd Redav Kned ritual multiple times.
[*] Hendrick Fisher no longer stops talking after buying a hook from him.
[*] If you stood directly above the popochipcard when stealing it, while getting caught by Lans & Merik, you got stuck in the bowl.
[*] Graphical error when standing inside one of the trash containers in Old Town.
[/list]
For the full list of user-reported bugs:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JpIfjEF0PmuFp-zpJn-__EMw6oNSym9vwkN6PfHY8hk/edit?pref=2&pli=1#gid=703231371

Cheers!
-Lars

- The mini Bankkrents do a bit less damage
